relationships.subject: KVD900
relationships.evidence_quote: KVD900 is a selective, competitive and reversible inhibitor of human PKa enzyme with a K<sub>i</sub> of 3.02 nM.

relationships.subject: KVD900
relationships.evidence_quote: The addition of KVD900 to plasma protected HK from DXS‐stimulated depletion in a concentration‐dependent manner with an IC50 of approximately 200 nM

relationships.subject: plasma kallikrein
relationships.evidence_quote: PKa‐mediated cleavage of HK generates bradykinin

relationships.subject: bradykinin
relationships.evidence_quote: BK and its metabolite desArg9 BK activate the cell surface receptors B2R and B1R, respectively, resulting in increased vascular permeability and pro‐inflammatory responses.

relationships.subject: KVD900
relationships.evidence_quote: DXS‐stimulated generation of FXIIa was reduced by >90% in plasma obtained at 1, 6 and 8 h post‐dose with KVD900 compared with pre‐dose plasma

key_findings: Oral KVD900 inhibited DXS-stimulated PKa activity by >=95% in HAE patients and protected HK from cleavage
KVD900 also suppressed PK consumption and FXIIa generation, limiting KKS amplification
